title: Krea 2 Turbo
description: Text to image with Krea 2 Turbo: fast. Can refine the prompt first.

labels.100:value: Describe the image: subject, setting, light and style.

controls.label: Final quality: upscale with SeedVR2 7B (slower; off = quick draft upscale)
Refine the prompt first (an LLM rewrites it before drawing)

hints: Describe the picture in full: who or what, where, the light, the camera and the style.
Aspect ratio sets the shape. Final quality upscales with SeedVR2 7B: sharper, and slower than the draft upscale.
Put the exact words you want written in the picture in quotes.
This model has no negative prompt: say what you want to see, not what to avoid.
